rules.text: Signals are evaluated on CLOSED candles; freqtrade's backtester enters at the next candle's open
No order types set in the strategy: the bot configuration decides (limit or market)
Stake size and max open trades are not in the strategy: they come from the bot configuration
No cooldown or pyramiding in the code: a new entry may follow the next signal after an exit
No session or time filter: trades around the clock
